data.name: Maqbul
data.gender_notes: Maqbul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'maqbul', meaning 'accepted, welcomed, pleasing to Allah'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes the belief that one's actions, prayers, and deeds are accepted by Allah. It also signifies the idea of being welcomed and blessed by Allah in both this world and the next. The name Maqbul carries the meaning “Accepted, Welcomed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maqbul usually hope their child will grow to embody accepted, welcomed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name symbolizes the belief that one's actions are accepted by Allah.
data.etymology: Maqbul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Accepted, Welcomed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maqbul total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
